Scenario: the world in January 1946. Below is a fragment of the country roster with its exact game ids.

AFG = Afghanistan
ALB = Albania
AND = Andorra
ARG = Argentina
BEL = Belgium
BGR = Bulgaria
BOL = Bolivia
BRA = Brazil
CHE = Switzerland
CHL = Chile
CHN = China
COL = Colombia

Task: for each listed country, name its RIVALS as of January 1946 - states with which it had a hostile or confrontational relationship at that exact date. Use ONLY ids from the list above; never invent ids or use ISO codes. A rivalry is mutual, list it under both sides. If a country had no rival among the listed ones, give an empty array.

Answer with JSON ONLY, no prose, shape: {"rivals": [{"id": "XXX", "rivals": ["YYY"], "why": "<=12 words"}]}
